interpretation.conclusion: Finding 5 overstates an inferred AD 313 as a competing primary date. The biography does not explicitly date the death to 313.
details: Jinshu086 s0013 reads 永甯初, not 永甯元年. s0132 reads 在州十三年,寢疾. Neither specifies inclusive calendar-year counting for an office tenure.

301 + 13 - 1 = 313 assumes inclusive calendar counting and an exact 301 appointment. 301 + 13 = 314 is compatible with elapsed duration. These calculations do not create two explicit primary witnesses. The biography alone leaves the death year unstated.

Jinshu005 s0465 (source order index235) supplies 建興元年; s0255(index275) opens 二年; s0264(index284) explicitly records 張軌薨 in fifth month 壬辰. Existing checked reign table makes this conventional AD314. No Gregorian month/day conversion was performed.

The later Tongjian-family reference already present in review3 gives 己丑. Do not harmonize its sexagenary day with Jinshu005 壬辰. Both support the same conventional year according to existing research; this task does not resolve the day discrepancy.
Preserve age60, reckoning traditional-inclusive, at claim410/413. Do not infer birth. Keep p001 and p073 separate; a date repair must not merge identities.

independentReviewRequirement: Fresh reviewer must independently verify primary witness, heading inheritance and conversion, then record its own pinned report references. Sidecar alone supplies no approval; retain sexagenary day discrepancy and all unrelated holds.
